# Nyctale

> Nyctale is a free, unlimited PC diagnostic app for Windows. It analyzes a computer and explains in plain language why it overheats or slows down, helping users avoid an unnecessary replacement. A Pro tier is also available for repair professionals to generate client-facing diagnostic reports.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://nyctale.fr/): Product overview, features, download.
- [Blog](https://nyctale.fr/blog): Guides on common PC issues (slowdowns, overheating, fan noise) and when to replace vs repair.

## Key facts
- Platform: Windows (desktop).
- Free and unlimited diagnostic for individual users.
- Pro tier (subscription) for repair shops: generates branded diagnostic reports for clients.
- Built and maintained by La Fabrik Numérique.

## Contact
- Website: https://nyctale.fr
